zh-CN.title: 投稿列表视觉优化
items: 投稿列表现在使用更清晰的流程样式，并优化了状态、标题和消息层级
我的投稿仅展示审批者，审批列表仅展示投稿者；多人头像与剩余人数更加清楚
投稿人和审批人标识统一为稳定的深绿色，不再随投稿状态变化

en.title: Clearer submission lists
items: Submission lists now use a clearer workflow layout with improved status, title, and message hierarchy
My submissions show reviewers while the review list shows authors, with cleaner multi-person avatars and overflow counts
Author and reviewer labels now keep a consistent deep-green treatment across every submission status
